method: Rows are copied from the official PDF text. A row is in 'rows' only when the matchup (e.g. MIL@ORL) is printed on that row; date and tip time come from the official schedule for that matchup. Everything else is in 'unattributed_rows' with the reason it could not be attached to a game. Reason text is verbatim; some words are joined in the PDF text (e.g. 'AnkleSprain') and were not altered. minutes_impact is intentionally null: no official minutes baseline was retrieved, so no rotation-minute value is stated.
